answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to stake a small deposit in a shared kernel of reputation: the deposit sits on a ledge, slashable if the agent misbehaves, but refunded with interest to honest agents. New identities start with zero trust and must wander through low-value, verifiable tasks before touching real money. Spinning up thousands of fakes then costs real capital and time, while one honest agent pays almost nothing.
